SELECT LEFT(start_time, 10) AS date, COUNT(*) AS showtime_count FROM movie_show_time WHERE deleted = 0 AND start_time >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND start_time < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE + 7, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY LEFT(start_time, 10) ORDER BY LEFT(start_time, 10)

SELECT b.id AS brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, COUNT(st.id) AS showtime_count FROM movie_show_time st INNER JOIN cinema c ON c.id = st.cinema_id AND c.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN brand b ON b.id = c.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE st.deleted = 0 AND st.start_time >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND st.start_time < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY COUNT(st.id) DESC

SELECT c.id AS cinema_id, c.name AS cinema_name, b.name AS brand_name, COUNT(st.id) AS showtime_count FROM movie_show_time st INNER JOIN cinema c ON c.id = st.cinema_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id = c.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE st.deleted = 0 AND st.start_time >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND st.start_time < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY c.id, c.name, b.name ORDER BY COUNT(st.id) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT pref.id AS prefecture_id, pref.name AS prefecture_name, region.name AS region_name, COUNT(st.id) AS showtime_count FROM movie_show_time st INNER JOIN cinema c ON c.id = st.cinema_id AND c.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN areas pref ON pref.id = c.prefecture_id LEFT JOIN areas region ON region.id = pref.parent_id WHERE st.deleted = 0 AND st.start_time >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND st.start_time < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND pref.parent_id BETWEEN 1 AND 8 GROUP BY pref.id, pref.name, region.name ORDER BY COUNT(st.id) DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_movies, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tmdb_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_tmdb, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE description IS NOT NULL AND description <> '') AS with_description, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE release_date IS NOT NULL) AS with_release_date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE home_page IS NOT NULL AND home_page <> '') AS with_home_page, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE movie_rate IS NOT NULL) AS with_movie_rate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE level_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_level FROM movie WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN st.yesterday_cnt > 0 THEN ROUND(((st.today_cnt - st.yesterday_cnt)::numeric / st.yesterday_cnt) * 100, 1) ELSE NULL END AS showtime_change_percent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM movie m2 WHERE m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.create_time::date < CURRENT_DATE )) AS movie_count_change, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cinema WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time::date = CURRENT_DATE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cinema c2 WHERE c2.deleted = 0 AND c2.create_time::date < CURRENT_DATE )) AS cinema_count_change FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie_show_time WHERE deleted = 0 AND start_time >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND start_time < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS today_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie_show_time WHERE deleted = 0 AND start_time >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND start_time < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS yesterday_cnt ) st
